transcript: A black dog always finds its way to a very strong soul. That is not a coincidence, it is spiritual selection. The black dog has a special vision of people. It reads the energetic field of every soul, and in its perception, it detects those who have not had it easy, people who carved their own path through effort, perseverance and setbacks, who went through difficult situations and forged a character and a will much stronger than the rest. That is what the black dog perceives, and that is exactly why it arrives, to provide energetic and spiritual companionship to those who need it. The energy of the black dog brings strength, but at the same time, it protects the path of its owner and keeps bad energies away. In our monastery, we have always held deep respect for black dogs. They are the most powerful guardians that exist, a person who has a black dog attracts envy, attracts stares, attracts ill will, because their light is strong, and a strong light always generates shadow around it. The black dog arrived precisely for that reason, to protect that light, to stand between you and what others want to send your way, to absorb what does not belong to you before it reaches you. If a black dog chose you do not take it lightly, it arrived because your soul needed it. Take care of it the way it takes care of you. Write in the comments, my black dog, if one chose you, but I want you to understand something. Your black dog protects you from what comes from the outside, but the heaviest burden you carry does not come from the outside. It comes from within, the years of struggle, of effort, of enduring, of holding yourself together alone. All of that left a weight inside that does not go away just because someone is protecting you. The accumulated stress of a difficult life stays in the body as tension, insomnia, exhaustion, and a guard you never let down. Your black dog watches over your space, but your inner peace is something only you can build. And if you want to release the weight you have been carrying and build the peace that your soul deserves after everything it fought through, I have spent more than 20 years quietly learning how to do that. And everything I know is inside the road back to calm. The link is in my profile.
